answer: Bind each identity to a non-amortizable originality deposit drawn from a shared glacier of prior peer-validated claims. Submissions are checked against that glacier for template overlap and receive a violet originality discount if family membership is high; only those clearing a shale layer of independent panel grades freeze into the deposit. Extra fake identities thus multiply the cost of producing genuinely distinct reasoning rather than merely multiplying keys, as neither the deposit nor the panel work pools across a coalition.
